project_type: TypeScript autonomous agent daemon for Solana revenue generation
test_framework: vitest with tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to check types. 2. Run npx vitest run to execute all tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js 24 available via nvm. No new npm dependencies allowed - only use existing ones (better-sqlite3, grammy, zod, winston, uuid, node-cron, @solana/web3.js, @jup-ag/api, dotenv). Node.js native modules (crypto, http, events, fs, path) are available.
contribution_requirements: All new files must be TypeScript. Follow existing patterns: Winston logger via createLogger(), Zod for validation, async/await. All public interfaces must use export. ESM modules with .js extensions in imports. Tests must be in tests/ mirroring src/ structure.
key_patterns: createLogger('module-name') for logging. Classes with constructor injection. Barrel exports via index.ts files. Test files use describe/it/expect from vitest. Config via src/config.ts with Zod schema. Types in src/types/index.ts. Telegram commands registered via registerXxxCommand pattern in separate files under src/telegram/commands/.
directory_structure: src/ contains core/ (agent logic, memory/, orchestrator/, streaming/, workflow/), strategies/ (revenue strategies), integrations/ (external service clients), telegram/ (bot + commands/), services/ (service clients), types/ (type definitions). tests/ mirrors src/ structure. data/ for SQLite DB. logs/ for Winston output.
